name: Rudolf II, Holy Roman Emperor
contribution: Holy Roman Emperor, King of Hungary and Croatia, King of Bohemia and Archduke of Austria.
image_credit: Joseph Heintz the Elder · Public domain

checks.lead: Rudolf II (18 July 1552 – 20 January 1612) was Holy Roman Emperor (1576–1612), King of Hungary and Croatia (as Rudolf I, 1572–1608), King of Bohemia (1575–1608/1611) and Archduke of Austria (1576–1608). He was a member of the House of Habsburg.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
